key_conclusion: Faceless-cartoon "money milestone / wealth-level" explainer for 25-45 earners; reach collapsed from 100k-1M views (Aug–Dec 2025) to ~3-8k (2026), and only concrete-life-stakes topics (housing, car payments, net-worth milestones) still break out — the format is copyable, the 2025 reach is not.

"Real numbers, no hype" contrarian money-math explainer (67.7k subs) with a small, steady audience (~1.8k median); investing-risk and debt-math topics outperform 2x+, while consumer "hidden cost" topics (subscriptions, BNPL, free shipping, credit utilisation) and tax/inflation topics repeatedly underperform.

Clearest niche-pivot case in the dataset: Jan-2026 general budgeting videos for young adults got 171-646 views, then from 31 Jan 2026 the channel switched to **retiree lifestyle & "what retirement with $X looks like"** and produced 15 breakouts (up to 1.08M views, PI 498) — audience choice, not script craft, made the channel.

High-volume (≈1 upload/day) illustrated "quiet wealth / frugal habits" listicles from a named female persona (105k subs, median ~10.6k views); calm-luxury and habits lists win, while psychology/behavioural-science and "hidden fees" explainers underperform — a consistent list machine whose winners sell a *feeling* (calm, control) rather than a number.

Animated "real math" decision explainer (19.8k subs, median 1.4k views) whose four mega-outliers (124k-495k, PI 33-244) are all **A-vs-B big-decision comparisons or the "after paying off your house" concept** — the same title/hook concepts that also win on Nick Invests — while abstract psychology and "levels" lists sink to ~600 views.

Senior-benefits "entitlement + deadline" channel (33.6k subs) with extreme variance: 22 breakouts up to 1.13M views (PI up to 373) on **"bills you legally stop paying after 65 / income the IRS can't touch / do this before [date]"**, but 29 underperformers at ~1-3k on **death, bank-freeze, IRS-levy and scam fear** — gain-framed entitlements win, loss-framed estate fears fail, with identical packaging.

Whiteboard-cartoon "Ivan" channel (29.9k subs, ~25 videos/month, 24-min lists) whose winners are **age-milestone reassurance lists ("Ready at 45?", "Secretly Ahead After 40") and wealth-threshold videos ($250K)**; generic habit lists, crash/asset videos, Japan tricks and "$3M danger" warnings flop — the same milestone/threshold concepts that win on Nick and Mark Invests.

Data-heavy early-retirement channel (14.9k subs, ~32 videos/month, 24-34 min) that wins with **"can I walk away?" net-worth thresholds and myth-busting retiree percentiles backed by the Fed's Survey of Consumer Finances**; technical-rule topics (IRMAA, inflation lines, sequencing) and abstract "traps" flop.
